title: DeathScatter
description: DeathScatter lets you configure how far items scatter when a player dies. Simple, lightweight, and fully configurable.
body:
# DeathScatter

DeathScatter is a lightweight and high-performance Paper plugin that gives you full control over how items behave when a player dies. Whether you want items to burst out in a wide radius or stack perfectly on a single pixel, DeathScatter has you covered.

### Features

- ✅ **Custom Scatter Radius**: Configure exactly how far items spread (0 to 50 blocks).
- ✅ **Anti-Scatter Mode (Radius 0)**: Unlike Vanilla Minecraft, setting the radius to 0 forces all items to stack perfectly on one spot with zero velocity.
- ✅ **High Performance**: Optimized to only trigger on death with minimal overhead.
- ✅ **Safety Limit**: Built-in cap of 50 blocks to prevent lag or accidental chunk loading issues.
- ✅ **Live Reloading**: Change settings on the fly with `/deathscatter reload`.
- ✅ **Global Support**: Works seamlessly across all worlds.

### Configuration

```yaml
# The radius in blocks within which items will be scattered.
# 0 = Anti-Scatter (perfectly stacked items)
# 1 = Standard spread
# Max: 50.0
scatter-radius: 1.0
```

### Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/deathscatter reload` | Reloads the configuration file | `deathscatter.reload` |
